To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the NPD effectiveness of SMEs in regulated industries is positively related to the use of a structured and systematic NPD process; (2) NPD effectiveness of the SMEs is positively related to a strong focus on the customer; and (3) NPD effectiveness is positively related to an internal focus, which is the focus on the internal resources and competences

SMEs can improve the performance of their NPD process by (a) developing a structured NPD process, (b) developing a strong internal innovation climate, and (c) having a strong focus on the external environment.
SMEs in regulated industries can be successful in N.P.D. if they optimize the effectiveness of their N.P.D. process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: What are the determinants of NPD success of SMEs in regulated industries?
the question: How can SMEs in highly regulated sectors be successful with NPD?
the following research questions: 1. How do SMEs in highly regulated sectors distinguish themselves from each other in terms of innovation effectiveness and efficiency?

the NPD performance is a function of the NPD process effectiveness.

the development of a successful NPD process requires the integration of the different phases and functions of the development process, and the integration of the NPD process with the other business processes.
the development process effectiveness is the key to the success of new products in highly regulated sectors.

the NPD process is not a linear one, but a cyclical one, and that the NPD performance is determined by the effectiveness of the NPD process and the NPD process effectiveness is determined by the management of the NPD project, the management of the development team and the development of the product concept.
